content.name: Elif Demir
content.title: Junior Data Analyst
content.summary: Junior data analyst at a Berlin parcel logistics company with an M.Sc. in Statistics from Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin and 15 months of working-student experience in mobility analytics. Strong in SQL, Python and Looker, with a master's thesis on demand forecasting for e-scooter sharing. Trilingual in German, Turkish and English.

experience.title: Junior Data Analyst
bullets: Maintain the daily delivery KPI dashboard in Looker for 9 depots, used by depot leads in their morning briefings.
Traced a rise in failed deliveries to incorrect address geocoding in two postcodes, a fix that recovered around €12,000 a month in re-delivery costs.
Wrote dbt models with tests for parcel scan events, reducing broken dashboard tiles reported by users from weekly to rare.

experience.title: Working Student, Data Analytics (Werkstudentin)
bullets: Prepared weekly fleet utilisation reports for 2,400 e-scooters across 12 districts, 20 hours a week alongside my master's studies.
Analysed ride data to propose new parking zones near three S-Bahn stations; the pilot raised rides per vehicle by 7%.
Documented 40 core tables in the data catalogue so new analysts could find the right sources without asking.

education.details: Grade 1.6. Thesis: short-term demand forecasting for shared e-scooters using gradient boosting.

education.school: Hochschule für Technik und Wirtschaft Berlin (HTW)

achievements.title: Hackathon finalist
achievements.detail: Team finalist at a Berlin open data hackathon (2023) with a map of cycle lane gaps built from public traffic data.

achievements.title: Statistics tutor
achievements.detail: Tutored first-year B.Sc. students in descriptive statistics for two semesters.
